opening.argument: The material presents free BNB through a flash-loan arbitrage bot as an “Easy trick” that is “100% Tested,” while directing viewers to copy contract code, connect a MetaMask wallet, deploy it, and enter a loan amount of at least 1000 BNB. It then requires sending BNB to the contract for gas and recommends another transfer if the first does not work. The demonstrated workflow includes deployment and execution in Remix, followed by a visible wallet transaction showing an approximately 0.15 BNB outflow. Although the recipient, contract behavior, actual profit, and any completed loss are not established, the video presents this high-risk payment-and-contract procedure as an easy route to rapid returns.

Change the environment to (injected Web3) and Connect your wallet when prompted (Metamask Preferable)
Enter your token details and deploy the contract (you can enter any name) and Enter the loan amount at least 1000 BNB
Send 0.2+ BNB to the contract to get the gas fee for all swaps
